body:
Established shopping-list UX (Bring!, AnyList, Google Keep lists): adding
items happens in bursts while planning — add milk, add bread, add eggs. Both
clients currently close the add dialog after each item, forcing reopen + 
refocus for every entry.

Fix (Android first): after a successful add, optionally keep the dialog open
with cleared fields and focus back in Name — e.g. an "Add another" secondary
action next to "Add", or a checkbox remembered across uses. Consider showing
top backlog suggestions when the name field is still empty (most-recently
checked-off items are the likeliest re-adds), which the registry data already
supports. Web can inherit the same pattern cheaply, lower priority.
Files: android ui/item/AddItemDialog.kt + ItemFormViewModel.kt; web
src/components/ItemDialog.tsx.
title: Add-item flow: 'add another' mode for consecutive adds (Android; optionally web)
